Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Flattened rice (Poha), Onions, Mustard seeds, Green chillies, Curry leaves, Turmeric, Peanuts, Lemon juice, Fresh coriander, Grated coconut, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Rinse poha and drain. 2. Heat oil, fry peanuts, add mustard seeds, green chillies, curry leaves, and chopped onions. Sauté until translucent. 3. Add turmeric and salt, then fold in poha. Cover and steam for 2 minutes. Garnish with lemon juice, coriander, and fresh coconut.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (7g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (3g), Vitamin C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Thin Poha, Fresh grated coconut, Coconut water / Cucumber juice, Mustard seeds, Green chillies, Curry leaves, Peanuts, Hing, Lemon juice, Salt, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix thin poha with grated coconut, coconut water, lemon juice, and salt; let it soften without cooking. 2. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, peanuts, green chillies, curry leaves, and hing. 3. Pour hot temper over poha, toss gently, cover with a plate (dadpe) for 5 minutes, and serve.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (7g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Bhajani flour (roasted Jowar, Bajra, Chana dal, Rice mix), Onions, Coriander, Ajwain, Sesame seeds, Cumin, Chilli powder, Turmeric, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix bhajani flour with onions, coriander, sesame seeds, spices, and water into a soft dough. 2. Flatten dough by hand on a damp cloth or butter paper, making 3-4 small holes in center. 3. Transfer to hot tawa, drizzle oil in holes and sides, cover, and cook until golden crisp on both sides.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (54g), Fiber (2g), Energy, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Soaked Tapioca pearls (Sabudana), Coarsely roasted peanut powder, Green chillies, Cumin seeds, Ghee, Sugar, Lemon juice, Rock salt (Sendha namak)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix soaked non-sticky sabudana with roasted peanut powder, salt, and sugar. 2. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and slit green chillies. 3. Add sabudana mixture and sauté on low flame until pearls turn translucent. Drizzle lemon juice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (34g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Minced Mutton (Keema), Onions, Tomatoes, Ginger-garlic paste, Malvani / Goda masala, Red chilli powder, Whole spices, Butter, Ladi Pao
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté whole spices, onions, and ginger-garlic paste in oil/butter. 2. Add tomatoes, spices, and minced mutton; sauté till moisture evaporates. 3. Add water, cover, and slow cook until keema is tender and gravy dries up. Serve piping hot with toasted buttered pav.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (9g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Besan (Gram flour), Jowar flour (Sorghum), Mustard seeds, Cumin, Garlic, Green chillies, Hing, Turmeric, Coriander, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk besan with water, salt, and turmeric into smooth thin batter. 2. Heat oil, temper mustard, cumin, crushed garlic, green chillies, and hing. Pour besan batter and cook stirring till thick and silky. 3. Serve hot with hand-patted Jowar Bhakri.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (9g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Besan, Jowar flour, Mustard seeds, Cumin seeds, Green chillies, Hing (Asafoetida), Turmeric, Oil/Ghee, Salt, Water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk besan with water, turmeric, and salt. 2. Heat oil, temper mustard, cumin, green chillies, and hing (no garlic or onion). 3. Pour besan slurry, cook stirring continuously until glossy and thick. Serve with warm Jowar Bhakri.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (4g), Folate, Energy
Ingredients Required: Toor dal, Steamed Indrayani rice, Desi Ghee (Toop), Hing, Turmeric, Cumin seeds, Salt, Lemon slice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and hing, then mash smoothly with salt and water. 2. Serve piping hot over steamed Indrayani rice with a generous pouring of fresh melted ghee (toop) and a splash of lemon juice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (38g), Fat (34g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Mutton with bones, Kolhapuri Kanda-Lasun masala, Roasted coconut paste, Sesame seeds, Poppy seeds, Milk/Coconut milk, Whole spices
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook mutton stock with ginger, garlic, and onions. 2. For Tambda Rassa: Sauté roasted coconut, kanda-lasun masala, add mutton stock and red chilli oil layer. 3. For Pandhra Rassa: Simmer mutton stock with white cashew paste, poppy seeds, sesame, and coconut milk.

Key Nutrients: Protein (35g), Fat (28g), Carbohydrates (10g), Fiber (3g), Vitamin B6, Niacin
Ingredients Required: Chicken, Fresh grated coconut, Roasted onions, Malvani Masala, Dry red chillies, Tamarind, Ginger-garlic, Coconut oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roast onions and grated coconut until deep brown; grind into fine Vatan paste with Malvani masala. 2. Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste and turmeric. 3. Heat oil, sauté chicken, add roasted coconut vatan, tamarind pulp, water, and simmer till cooked.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (4g), Sodium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Boiled potatoes, Besan batter, Garlic-chilli paste, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Turmeric, Dry garlic chutney, Ladi Pav, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté mustard, curry leaves, crushed garlic-chillies, turmeric; mix into mashed potatoes. 2. Roll into balls, dip in spiced besan batter, deep fry until crisp. 3. Serve inside pav smeared with spicy red garlic chutney and green chilli.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (13g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (5g), Potassium
Ingredients Required: Raw bananas (boiled & mashed), Besan batter, Green chillies, Ginger (optional for strict Jain, omit), Mustard seeds, Hing, Turmeric, Dry coconut-chilli chutney, Jain Pav / Bread
Recipe Instructions: 1. Temper mustard seeds, green chillies, and hing in oil; mix with boiled mashed raw bananas and turmeric. 2. Shape into vadas, dip in besan batter, and deep fry. 3. Serve inside pav with dry coconut-red chilli chutney (no garlic).

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (8g), Iron, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Sprouted Matki (Moth beans), Farsan/Chooda, Onions, Tomatoes, Ginger-garlic, Kanda Lasun Masala, Tamarind, Coriander, Pav, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook sprouted matki with turmeric and salt. 2. Prepare spicy red watery gravy (Kat/Rassa) by frying onion-coconut paste, ginger-garlic, and kanda lasun masala in excess oil until red oil floats. 3. Assemble: Matki, top with crisp farsan, pour boiling Kat, onions, and coriander. Serve with pav.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (6g), Vitamin A, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Fresh coriander leaves (finely chopped), Besan, Sesame seeds, Green chilli-garlic paste, Turmeric, Red chilli powder, Ajwain, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix chopped coriander, besan, sesame seeds, spices, and little water into a thick rollable dough. 2. Steam rolls for 15-20 minutes until firm. 3. Slice into cylinders and shallow or deep fry in oil until golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (26g), Fiber (8g), Potassium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Small purple Brinjals, Roasted peanut powder, Roasted coconut, Goda Masala, Ginger-garlic paste, Tamarind paste, Jaggery, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slit brinjals crosswise. 2. Stuffing: Mix peanut powder, coconut, goda masala, chilli powder, tamarind, jaggery, ginger-garlic, and salt. 3. Stuff brinjals tightly. Heat oil, add stuffed brinjals, remaining masala, water, and slow cook till tender.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (25g), Fiber (8g), Potassium
Ingredients Required: Small Brinjals, Roasted peanut powder, Grated dry coconut, Goda masala, Red chilli powder, Hing, Tamarind pulp, Jaggery, Salt, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slit brinjals into four quarters keeping stem intact. 2. Make stuffing with peanut powder, coconut, goda masala, hing, tamarind, jaggery, chilli powder, and salt (no garlic/ginger). 3. Stuff brinjals and sauté in oil on low flame with lid covered until soft.

Key Nutrients: Protein (32g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (18g), Fiber (1g), Omega-3, Iodine
Ingredients Required: Surmai (Kingfish) steaks, Malvani masala, Ginger-garlic, Kokum extract (Agul), Turmeric, Semolina (Rava), Rice flour, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate fish with kokum extract, ginger-garlic, turmeric, and Malvani masala for 20 mins. 2. Mix rava and rice flour with salt and red chilli. 3. Coat fish steaks in rava mixture and shallow fry on medium heat till golden brown and crispy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (8g), Iron
Ingredients Required: Besan, Jowar Bhakri, Mustard seeds, Cumin seeds, Green chillies, Hing, Turmeric, Coriander leaves, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat oil, add mustard, cumin, green chillies, and hing. 2. Add dry besan, turmeric, salt, and splash water while roasting continuously to form dry crumbly zunka. Serve hot with Jowar Bhakri.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (5g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Chana dal, Jaggery (Gul), Cardamom powder, Nutmeg (Jaiphal), Whole wheat flour, All-purpose flour, Ghee, Milk
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook chana dal, drain water, mash with jaggery, cardamom, and nutmeg over heat until thick (Puran). 2. Prepare soft wheat dough (Katani). 3. Stuff generous puran inside dough, roll thin, cook on tawa with liberal Desi Ghee.

Key Nutrients: Protein (3g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (3g), Calcium, Energy
Ingredients Required: Rice flour (Ukad), Fresh grated coconut, Jaggery, Cardamom powder, Poppy seeds, Nutmeg, Ghee, Water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook filling: Fresh coconut, jaggery, poppy seeds, cardamom, nutmeg in ghee until combined. 2. Make steamed dough with rice flour and boiling water. 3. Shape into pleated pockets, fill with coconut mix, seal into modak shape, and steam for 10-12 minutes. Serve with ghee.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Hung Curd (Chakka), Powdered sugar, Saffron strands in warm milk, Cardamom powder, Charoli, Chopped pistachios & almonds
Recipe Instructions: 1. Strain fresh curd through cheesecloth overnight to extract whey and get hung curd (Chakka). 2. Whisk chakka with powdered sugar until smooth and creamy. 3. Fold in saffron milk, cardamom powder, and charoli. Chill before serving.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Vitamin D
Ingredients Required: Full fat milk, Sugar, Saffron, Cardamom powder, Nutmeg, Slivered almonds, Pistachios, Charoli
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil full-fat milk in a wide heavy pan, reducing it to half while continuously scraping cream sides. 2. Add sugar, saffron, cardamom, nutmeg, and nuts. 3. Simmer for another 10 minutes until thick and golden. Serve chilled or warm.
